name: google-project-sync
goal: Same Google account discovers owned and joined projects automatically across clients, with revocation and account isolation

evidence: Reuse verified Google identity and server-side membership. Projects refresh automatically across owned/joined account clients; revoked or old-account views are removed without leaking credentials. Local-only folders are not implicitly uploaded.

Current auth and invitation suites prove login and membership, while UI lists load only once. Extend existing hosted access, native connection and workspace listing suites with second-client changes, lifecycle disposal, identity races and revoked selection.
